Team —

Attached is the first pass owner matrix for the quarter (Q3_owner_matrix_v1.xlsx). I pulled together owners, primary metrics, SLA/latency targets, and a short risk/mitigation column per objective. High level asks:

- Please review your assigned objectives and confirm owner commitment or propose a reassignment.
- Call out any metric gaps (data, dependency, or resourcing) that would prevent deliverable sign-off by launch.
- If you need additional headcount or contractor hours, attach a short note and I’ll route to GtM/Finance for prioritization.

Major open items I flagged:
- Inference unit cost target for "Search Summaries" looks aggressive given current batch sizes (see row 4).
- Data export SLA for EU customers needs sign-off — legal/infra dependency.

Can everyone respond with confirmations or gaps by EOD Monday, 12 Jul? After that I’ll consolidate and loop in execs for final approval.

Attachments: Q3_owner_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
